cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded IRCTC card from RBL rewarding train bookings with accelerated points, surcharge waivers, and travel benefits for frequent rail travelers.

items.child: Complimentary train cancellation protection cover of up to Rs 5,000.

benefitRows.name: Cancellations
benefitRows.description: Complimentary train cancellation protection cover of up to Rs 5,000.
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary train cancellation protection cover of up to Rs 5,000 in case your train is cancelled.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to RBL Bank Customer Care at 1800 102 6222 or email rblcare@rblbank.com.
